'''July 2000 Rancho Cucamonga tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rancho Cucamonga, California on 28 July 2000. It is known from Ryan Schueller's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-alderaan-regional-7-29-2kd1063/ alderaan-regional-7-29-2k], DeckTech (Ryan "Mage" Schueller, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-alderaan-regional-7-29-2kd1063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Rancho Cucamonga, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
